text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa and I are headed to the

academy after a day out when we decide
to stop
in a clothing shop.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...This one's pretty nice. Hey.
Go try this
on.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Yeah. You. Go make it look great.
choice_data_list: Wait, I'm wearing it?
Wait, I have to wear that?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She hands me a slim-cut white jacket to
try on. I
feel awkward because I've never
worn anything
like this before.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hey, stop looking around like that. Look
at me,
and don't look away.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Straighten your shoulders. Stick your
chest out a
bit. Now lift your chin.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh. Now you're lookin' the part.
C'mon, let's
go.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Just to a little place I know.
choice_data_list: Wait, g-go where...?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You'll see when we get there. Just act
confident.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
We're here. I used to hit up this ramen
spot all the
time, but for certain reasons,
I haven't been in a
while.

text_block_list.name: Rough Looking Man
text_block_list.text:
Well, would ya look at that! It's
Nakayama!
Haven't seen your face
around here in a while.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Well, here I am. Now will you let me eat
in peace?

text_block_list.name: Rough Looking Man
text_block_list.text:
Bahahaha! That's really how you're
gonna be?
You know good and well that
we've got a score to
settle.

text_block_list.name: Rough Looking Man
text_block_list.text:
I'm 'bout to get back everything I've
ever lost
from you, Nakayama!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The man inches toward Nakayama Festa.
I quickly
put myself between the two of
them.

text_block_list.name: Rough Looking Man
text_block_list.text: 'Scuse me?!
choice_data_list: ...Could you just leave me alone?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I straighten my shoulders, stick my chest
out a
bit, and lift my chin...

text_block_list.name: Rough Looking Man
text_block_list.text: Who the hell're you?!
choice_data_list: I won't say it twice.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I forgot to introduce you. This is my
trainer.

text_block_list.name: Rough Looking Man
text_block_list.text:
Your trainer?! Looks more like someone
from our
neck of the woods!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't let my guard down yet. I'll defeat
him with
sheer determination!

text_block_list.name: Rough Looking Man
text_block_list.text: ...Fine, whatever. Sorry to bother ya.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Heh... Hahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I've got a long history with this lot, but
I've never
seen any of them make a face
like that. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hm? I think it's over already. I bet on
you, and I
won.
choice_data_list: We still have a race after this, d...
We still have a race after this, d...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I was betting on whether you'd get the
guy to
back down before anything even
got started.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
That's what I brought you along for.
With your out-of-the-box tactics, bluffs,
and the courage to throw yourself in the
fray, the outcome was clear from the
very start.
choice_data_list: So that's how it was...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Don't get too happy, we're still in the
tiger's den
here.
choice_data_list: If I was able to help, I'm glad!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Just let what's inside shine through.
Always stay
sharp.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...If your goal is to stay by my side.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hmph...
I'll invite you out like this again 
sometime, when I feel like having
another quiet
meal.
choice_data_list: ...Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hmph...
I'll invite you out like this again 
sometime, when I feel like having
another quiet
meal.
choice_data_list: Leave it to me anytime.
When push comes to shove, I can co...
Come to think of it, I've worked u...
Come to think of it, I've worked u...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You're so reliable. You know, there are
other
places close by I have a hard time
walking into.
choice_data_list: Leave it to me anytime.
When push comes to shove, I can co...
Come to think of it, I've worked u...
Come to think of it, I've worked u...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
There's a soba noodles joint, and
okonomiyaki... Delicious places, but
they're all full of people
from back in
the day.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hopefully your bluffs will make them
back off.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Hahaha! Now you're really acting
the part!
choice_data_list: We'll cross that bridge when we co...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa's laughter is infectious.
We
continue to talk and savor our
delicious meal!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The second I finish saying that,
I feel the
eyes of
everyone in the restaurant on my
back.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Didn't I just say we're still in the
tiger's den?
Anyway... I doubt anyone'll try
going up against
you this time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I got careless. Now I feel bad for making
her
nervous.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Someone's got a big heart! I've taught
you well.
choice_data_list: If you'd like, why don't we all ma...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We clink our glasses together, and the
entire store goes into an uproar. I
apologize to
Nakayama Festa, and she
replies with a smile!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You're hungry already, after all that
tension?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haha. That's for sure. It wasn't even
close.
choice_data_list: Compared to before the race, this ...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The regular customers break out into discussion. "No way racing can be that cutthroat," they protest.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
You caught everyone's attention.
Don't
you guys know? Racing is where the real

thrill's at.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Come check it out if you want. You
won't regret
it...
Right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I give Nakayama Festa a firm nod, and
she smiles
back at me!
